botcomponent.description: Opens and analyses the original source documents in the SharePoint intake folder when the Accounting data store cannot fully answer: figures or details never extracted (line items, tax breakdown, terms, bank details, wording), verifying or challenging a stored figure, explaining a partial extraction or anomaly note, comparing or reconciling several documents, or when the accountant explicitly asks to look at the original. Handles native and scanned PDF, Word, Excel (multi-sheet) and CSV, cites page/sheet/section, and states honestly what could not be read. Use after checking the data store with query-accounting-data; read-only (saving results is handled by write-back-changes).
botcomponent.name: ad-hoc-source-document-analysis
